item.title: Patch now: Vates Xen Orchestra: Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input
item.description:
Vates Xen Orchestra: exploited · fix: 5.211.2, 5.213.1, 6.9.2 · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update Vates Xen Orchestra to the fixed version for your release line (for example 5.211.2, 5.213.1 or 6.9.2).

Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform actions with administrative privileges via a specially crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-133469
